description: This source file implements utility functions to resolve and construct commands for running npm (Node Package Manager) in different environments, with special handling for Windows and cross-platform compatibility. It exports a main function 'resolveNpmRunner' which determines the appropriate command configuration based on the runtime environment and provided parameters.

methods.name: resolvePathEnvKey
methods.description: Returns the environment variable key name for PATH, defaulting to 'PATH' if not found.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes a command-line argument for Windows cmd.exe, throwing if unsafe characters are present.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Builds a complete command line string for Windows cmd.exe with escaped arguments.

methods.name: resolveToolchainNpmRunner
methods.description: Resolves the npm executable and related commands based on user parameters, platform, and environment.
